## Wave 0 Summary

Wave 0 is the session's **dependency-tier setup wave** — it runs FIRST, before any compute wave. It lands the cross-cutting Stage-3-promotion sequencing record (mack-synthesis §V.1), the anti-inflation K-counter consistency check (mack §V.2), and — load-bearing — creates `sessions/framework/s93-slot-pre-allocation-lockfile.md` reserving the 7 colliding STAGE-3-PERMANENT registry-write slots (§VII.AU / §VII.AW / §VII.AY / §VII.AV / §VII.AX / §VII.BB / §VII.BE). The 7 Tier-3 STAGE-3-flip gates (W2-2, W3-6, W4-2, W5-2, W5-5, W6-3, W6-4) depend on this lockfile to avoid parallel-writer registry-write collisions; W0 MUST land before any of them fires (else they honestly close PRE-REG-INC per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` and re-run after W0).

## Wave 0 Decision Point Prerequisites

NONE — Wave 0 is the FIRST wave; it consumes only closed-S92 synthesis (mack-synthesis §V.1/§V.2), the S93 context file, the corpus §18-§23 DIRECTIVEs, and the `s90-slot-pre-allocation-lockfile.md` template. It supplies the lockfile + sequencing record that every downstream Tier-3 gate consumes.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  The cross-cutting Stage-3-promotion sequencing pre-registration is complete: (a) the 3-tier dependency-ordered
  sequencing record is landed with each of the 7 Tier-3 STAGE-3-flip gates citing its upstream CF IDs +
  substrate-input-orthogonality predicate; (b) the anti-inflation K-counter check pins the orthogonality basis for
  the 5 corpus DIRECTIVEs §18-§23 (plus W9-3 bridge-map-scheme axis-β + W9-4 per-pole axis — each advancing its OWN
  axis, no double-count, W-2 base-CLASS topological-stopping-rule cited); (c) `s93-slot-pre-allocation-lockfile.md`
  exists with 7 RESERVED-FOR blocks. The S93 STAGE-3 program can now execute in dependency order with no Stage-3
  flip front-loaded before its anchor-supplying CF and no parallel-writer registry-write collision. This gate is the
  upstream prereq the 7 Tier-3 gates cite for slot-collision avoidance.
FAIL_meaning: >
  A deliverable is incomplete: a Tier-3 gate is missing its CF-ID or substrate-input-orthogonality citation, OR the
  anti-inflation check fails to pin an orthogonality axis (a double-count risk remains), OR the lockfile is missing a
  RESERVED-FOR block / a template field. A FAIL means the S93 STAGE-3 program lacks its sequencing guard — a Tier-3
  flip could be front-loaded or two registry-writes could collide. FAIL routes to completing the missing deliverable
  before any Tier-3 gate dispatches (the Tier-3 gates honestly close PRE-REG-INC pending this lockfile per
  mechanical-closure-discipline.md).
INFO_meaning: >
  The sequencing record + lockfile are present but one Tier-3 gate's substrate-input-orthogonality predicate is
  CONTESTED (e.g., a Stage-2 verify where both cross-reviewers load the same data file — substrate-input-OVERLAP
  rather than orthogonality, per joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Substrate-input-orthogonality clause" Verdict-B). INFO
  records the sequencing + lockfile + the substrate-input-OVERLAP caveat on the contested gate (which then carries
  the explicit overlap caveat at its Stage-2 PASS-AND per the K=2 structural-ceiling discipline).

## Wave 0 → downstream Decision Point

W0-1 is the upstream prereq for ALL 7 Tier-3 STAGE-3-flip gates this session:

- **On PASS**: the lockfile `sessions/framework/s93-slot-pre-allocation-lockfile.md` is LIVE; the 7 Tier-3 gates (W2-2, W3-6, W4-2, W5-2, W5-5, W6-3, W6-4) each confirm their slot is RESERVED before their registry-write, and the orchestrator dispatches the compute waves in dependency-tier order (Tier-1 → Tier-2 → Tier-3) per the sequencing record. The sequencing record is consumed by the orchestrator at `/rclab-coordinate` dispatch time and by each Tier-3 gate's `Depends on` field.
- **On FAIL/incomplete-at-dispatch**: any Tier-3 gate that fires before W0-1 lands honestly closes PRE-REG-INC (`value='PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_s93_slot_lockfile_NOT-LANDED'`) and re-runs after W0-1 per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md`.
